name: deepinfra-deploy-qwen
description: Deploy a Qwen-family model onto DeepInfra Deployments, where the platform runs the engine: `machine acquire --provider deepinfra-deploy` renders the one service.start below into the platform's deploy request, and what comes back is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint rather than a host. The model is yours to declare: replace the SET-ME placeholder with the Hugging Face repo id you intend to serve (a private repo adds "deepinfra-deploy.hf.token_env", the name of the variable holding the read token — the value never reaches an argv). No requires_ports and no requires_disk: the deployment exposes nothing of its own and the platform holds the weights, so a profile declaring either is refused at admission. The GPU is chosen from min_vram_gb as the cheapest catalogued configuration that clears it, or named outright with "deepinfra-deploy.gpu". min_instances 0 lets the deployment scale to nothing between requests; the pod verbs (apply, logs, exec, cp, port-forward) do not apply to such a machine and say so.
